hero.name: Auto team

hero.summary: From idea to delivery: sales, engineering, research, and support work together so what we ship feels clear and fast — especially on mobile.

about.title: Why Auto team
about.body: We are a product team that refuses to split research, build, and support into silos. We aim for experiences that read clearly in the first mobile viewport and stay reliable after delivery.
about.valueOneBody: Each section has one job: show what we build, who stands behind it, and how to continue the conversation.
about.valueTwoBody: Sales, engineering, research, and support share one narrative so the gap from idea to care stays short.

points: Sales, engineering, research, and support became four clear departments.
A shared product-and-care rhythm was defined.
Pulse, Relay, Lens, and Harbor were introduced as the product skeleton.
Focus shifted to mobile experience and a unified team narrative.
Web, sales, and AI cases were gathered into one portfolio.
Support entered the delivery plan from day one.
